crop.notes: Headline 'Pedestrians and Pugilists'; first paragraph is about a pedestrian race, the second paragraph is the Allen item. Both complete.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported from New York that Richard K. Fox had deposited $1,000 with Harry Hill to back Tom Allen, ex-champion of America, against any pugilist, John L. Sullivan preferred, for the championship of the world.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Republican: St. Louis, Tuesday Morning, October 31, 1882'; the paper was the Missouri Republican until 1888.

facts.fact: Richard K. Fox deposited $1,000 with Harry Hill and challenged on Allen's behalf any pugilist, John L. Sullivan preferred, for the championship of the world and $1,000 to $2,500 a side, the fight within 100 miles of New Orleans within three months of signing
